investigator.method: Bounded, single unauthenticated Level-1 PASSIVE_STATIC GET (curl, descriptive User-Agent, redirects followed, 20s timeout, no retry, no authentication, no CAPTCHA/challenge bypass, no browser) against the venue's official_website (falling back to official_programme_url where noted), as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 batch 6 of 7.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated Level-1 static GET against https://thetopsecretcomedyclub.co.uk/events-listings/ retained enough real evidence (event/programme listing content, title/meta tags, and structured data where present) to reach an honest, evidenced REJECT decision without needing to escalate to Level 2/3/4.

identity.notes: The retained page's own <title> ('The Top Secret Comedy Club, Covent Garden, London - Whats on.') and meta description directly self-identify the domain as the venue's own official events listing.

site_classification.platform: WordPress-based events listing with data-event-* attributes per event list item.

venue_location.notes: Discovery evidence reports Kingsway 23, WC2B 6UJ, London; the retained excerpt shows the venue's own listing links reference '170 Drury Lane' as its performance address.

reasons: The retained events-listing excerpt shows real, dated current listings that are explicitly stand-up comedy shows ('Tuesday Stand Up Comedy Show With Two Top Secret Guests!', 'Thomas Green & Co (EXTRA SHOW) With A Top Secret Special Guest!') with comedian line-ups, not music performances.

The venue's own <title>/meta description self-identify it as 'Best Stand up Comedy Club in the U.K.' — matching the policy's guidance that this venue is almost certainly comedy, confirmed here by real retained evidence rather than the venue name alone.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, genuine excerpts (contiguous literal substrings) of the actual HTTP response body from a single unauthenticated GET, plus response metadata (status/content-type/title); JSON wrapper around literal excerpt strings, so not byte-faithful as a whole file.
evidence.method: curl -L (redirects followed); descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated GET; 20-second timeout; no retry; no browser/JS execution.
